SUBJECT:
feat(web): add the Claude SDK variant of SessionClient and its model catalog
BODY:
Claude still runs over ACP: the new path is gated off in production and only
reachable from tests until the core launch table selects it.

- claude_sdk_spawn: selector, launch resolution (node plus the embedded
  sidecar), fail-closed restore (a missing session or a different resumed id
  becomes the typed restore-rejected error), operator-pin application and the
  spawn report, mirroring the Pi path
- SessionClient::Claude: a third variant with arms mirroring Pi; cancel
  returns an empty outcome, permission/elicitation responses are rejected
  because the sidecar auto-approves and declines elicitation
- catalog: the Claude model catalog is read from the SDK handshake through a
  helper shared with the Pi reader
- sidecar: an explicit --sdk-module is now exclusive, so an override that
  cannot load fails init instead of silently loading the installed SDK
- tests: spawn, enum, catalog and override cases against the fake SDK
